name: Boschendal Manor House

dates.note: The SAHRA description gives the grant to Jean le Long in 1685 and the manor house to his descendant Paul de Villiers in 1812, which is exactly what the node's exemplar note already says.

quotes.text: This farm was originally granted to the Huguenot Jean le Long in 1685, Afterwards the property became the home of Jacques de Villiers and his wife Marguerite Gardiol. Their grandson, Paul, built the historic manor house in 1812. Type of site: Farm Complex.
quotes.page: SAHRA identifier 9/2/069/0041, description column of the Paarl heritage-site table. A register description is not paginated.

note: Tranche 3, Cape cluster, 5 September 2026. The register row confirms the two dates the node's exemplar note carries -- the 1685 Huguenot grant and the 1812 manor -- and says nothing whatever about the holbol gables the node names, the plan, the thatch or the walls. The comma splice after '1685' is the table's own and is quoted as printed.
